diocese: Iglesia Episcopal, Diócesis de Puerto Rico
sourceFile: Diocesan wall-calendar PDF ("calendario_diocesano_2026.pdf", 30 pages), fetched directly from https://www.episcopalpr.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/calendario_diocesano_2026.pdf -- only each month's own "Intercesiones" section was transcribed (see notes).
notes: This source ("calendario_diocesano_2026.pdf", a 30-page diocesan wall calendar) combines several distinct sections: a monthly saints'/commemorations grid, a per-week "Intercesiones" (intercessions) section, an "Actividades y Reuniones" (diocesan meetings/boards schedule) list, and, at the end of the document, "Cumpleaños y Aniversarios" (clergy birthdays/ordination anniversaries) and "Lecturas 2026" (lectionary readings) sections. Only the "Intercesiones" section -- the diocese's own weekly cycle of prayer -- was transcribed into this file; the calendar grid's own liturgical Sunday names, the meetings list, clergy birthdays, and lectionary readings are excluded as out of scope for this corpus.

Every subject in this source's Intercesiones section is phrased as a full intercession sentence beginning "Por ..." ("For ..."), mixing worldwide Anglican Communion provinces/dioceses, Puerto Rico diocesan offices/institutions/ministries (including, on January 18, the diocesan cathedral: "Por la Catedral San Juan Bautista y su cabildo"), and general prayer concerns in one undifferentiated list -- none of it is printed as a bare congregation name plus city the way this corpus's schema expects for subject type "parish". Every subject here is therefore recorded as type "category", using the full printed sentence (including its leading "Por") as `name`, exactly as printed.

This document was rendered to page images (300 DPI) and read visually rather than trusted from a linearized `pdftotext -layout` extraction, per this corpus's standing rule for multi-column sources -- and this was essential here: the mini reference-calendar boxes printed beside each month's Intercesiones section bled stray digits into the linearized text (e.g. a real header "1 - Por la Iglesia Anglicana de México" was extracted as "51 - ...", and June's real "21 - Por la Iglesia Anglicana del África Austral" was extracted as "28 - ..."). Every one of the 12 months' Intercesiones sections in this file was transcribed from the rendered page image, not the linearized text.

The printed date number heading each week's intercessions does not reliably track the actual liturgical Sunday shown in that month's calendar grid on the same page. Most months' list starts on calendar day "1" even when the 1st is not a Sunday (e.g. April 1, June 1, July 1, September 1, October 1, and December 1, 2026 are all weekdays, not Sundays), and several months' last printed entry does not match that month's real last Sunday either: April's last entry is printed "21" (a Tuesday) rather than the 26th (the real last Sunday); June's list stops at "21" and omits the 28th; July's list stops at "19" and omits the 26th; August's five entries (1, 10, 19, 26, 30) do not align with August's real Sundays (2, 9, 16, 23, 30) except the last. These are preserved exactly as printed rather than silently corrected to the nearest real Sunday, per this corpus's standing rule against fixing a source's own document. Because of this mismatch, `liturgicalNote` is left null on every entry: attaching the calendar grid's own Sunday label to a date that does not actually match it would fabricate a linkage the source itself does not draw.

Several small apparent typos/grammar irregularities in the source's own Spanish text are preserved verbatim rather than corrected, e.g.: "Por toda la toda la Comunión Anglicana..." (January 11, a duplicated phrase), "Pora que haya amor y justicia en el mundo" (April 21, for "Para que"), "Por todas las personas que entregar su vida..." (May 1, apparently for "entregan"), and "Por los enfermos que están nuestros Hospitales Episcopales" (May 10, apparently missing "en" before "nuestros").

Several subject sentences wrap across two printed lines in the source (e.g. "Por la Iglesia Anglicana de la Región Central / de América", November 1); these were rejoined into one continuous `name` with a single space, since this is a physical line-wrap rather than a change in wording. This is distinct from September 1's first subject, "Por la Provincia Episcopal / Anglicana de Alejandría", whose internal "/" is printed within a single line in the source itself (an apparent either/alternate naming for that province) and is preserved as printed.

The diocese's own name is given here exactly as printed on the document's cover, whose logo reads "IGLESIA EPISCOPAL" with "DIÓCESIS DE PUERTO RICO" beneath it in smaller type -- transcribed as "Iglesia Episcopal, Diócesis de Puerto Rico".

Several dated entries (May 31, August 30, November 29, and December 13/20/25/27) print only a single intercession sentence with no further elaboration, unlike most other weeks, which list several; this is exactly what the source itself prints for those dates, not a truncated transcription.
